csrf.conditional_exemption: Passkey registration begin/complete may use an X-Activation-Token instead of cookie authentication.

session_transitions.result: hashed server record plus session and CSRF cookies

session_transitions.trigger: current time is later than expires_at
current time is later than last_seen_at plus the configured inactivity lifetime

session_transitions.result: current record revoked and both cookies cleared

session_transitions.trigger: account owner revokes an active session
session_transitions.result: target record revoked; current-session cookies also cleared

session_transitions.trigger: expired or revoked record passes its separately configured retention cutoff

reauthentication.mechanism: fresh passkey verification timestamps the current server session
reauthentication.policy: Destructive, credential, governance, evidence, recovery, high-availability and security-setting operations identified by route dependencies require recent reauthentication.

browser_stores.content: opaque session token and request-integrity token
browser_stores.removed: logout, current-session revocation, browser removal or cookie expiry
browser_stores.retention: bounded by server absolute session expiry

browser_stores.content: preferences, offline opt-in and bounded offline access metadata; no session token or calendar payload
browser_stores.created: explicit preference or successful online access
browser_stores.removed: preference removal, logout where applicable, denied/expired access or browser site-data removal
browser_stores.retention: preference-specific; offline marker expires no later than the configured window or local end of day

browser_stores.content: tab-only announcement state and transient activation, recovery or shared-route capability
browser_stores.removed: tab close; route secret also removed after completion or definitive rejection

browser_stores.content: transient route capability after removal from the visible URL
browser_stores.removed: completion or definitive rejection; otherwise browser history lifecycle

browser_stores.content: explicitly enabled, schema-validated participant-safe offline calendar payload
browser_stores.created: successful durable write after explicit opt-in
browser_stores.removed: expiry, invalid schema, authorisation denial, logout, explicit removal or loss of access
browser_stores.retention: configured offline access window, additionally capped at local end of day

browser_stores.content: versioned static application shell and static assets; never authenticated API responses
browser_stores.created: service-worker install or static asset fetch
browser_stores.removed: service-worker activation replaces an old release or browser site-data removal

external_boundaries: Browser profile synchronisation, device or OS backups and provider copies are outside application control.
Application cleanup success does not prove physical deletion from copies outside controlled systems.
